rule.explanation: Pipeline-aware coordinated boost: node0 and node1 increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low, while node2 boosts less to avoid overstocking. Reduces orders when pipeline is excessive relative to backlog.
Backlog-driven proportional boost: each node increases order proportionally to its backlog, capped at 6, to clear backlogs quickly while avoiding excessive orders when backlog is small.
Pipeline-aware relaxation: reduce orders when pipeline is high relative to backlog to prevent over-ordering, and increase when backlog is high and pipeline is low.

rule.explanation: Coordinated pipeline-aware relaxation: reduce orders when pipeline is high and inventory is low to avoid upstream backlog, but increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low to improve service. Node-specific thresholds.
Growth-responsive ordering: increase orders when recent demand growth is high, but cap increases to avoid overshoot. Reduce orders when growth is low and pipeline is high.
Backlog-driven service improvement: increase orders when backlog is high and inventory is zero, but reduce orders when pipeline is very high to prevent upstream congestion.
